pages.text: Power $(item)wire$() is laid like redstone and climbs walls. $(item)Waterproof wire$() survives in water. A $(item)wire passthrough$() turns a solid block into a conductor for both power and coax, keeping its look, so cables can go through walls.$(br2)Use coax on a laid wire (or wire on coax) and both lie in one block as a $(l:radiocraft:antennas/coax)wire bundle$(/l).

pages.title: Coloured wire
pages.text: Wire comes in sixteen colours, like coax: a colour joins only its own colour or plain wire, so two runs can lie side by side, or share a bundle, without becoming one circuit. Plain wire joins any colour. Wire is thin and coax fat, so you can tell them apart whatever the colour.$(br2)Use a dye on laid wire to colour the whole run (sneak for one block), or craft eight wire round a dye. Waterproof wire stays plain.
